_about: Things you never want an agent to touch. AgentScope checks every tool call (command, file path, URL) and every reply Claude writes against this list, and reads the file again when it changes. urls and paths ignore case, and a path starting with ~/ matches any home folder. env matches the whole variable name, exact case. text matches exactly. Each entry is "what to match": "why it matters".

urls.webhook.site: Free request catcher: a common place to send stolen data
urls.requestbin: Request catcher, used the same way
urls.pipedream.net: Request catcher, used the same way
urls.ngrok-free.app: A tunnel to someone else's machine
urls.ngrok.io: A tunnel to someone else's machine
urls.interact.sh: Out-of-band callback host used to confirm an exploit worked
urls.burpcollaborator.net: Out-of-band callback host used to confirm an exploit worked
urls.169.254.169.254: Cloud metadata service: hands out the machine's cloud credentials

env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: A leaked model key becomes someone else's token bill
env.OPENAI_API_KEY: A leaked model key becomes someone else's token bill

paths.~/.config/gh/hosts.yml: The GitHub CLI's token, which the 2025 Nx attack went looking for

text.sk_live_: A live Stripe secret key, in the open
text.PRIVATE KEY-----: A private key, in the open
text.ghp_: A GitHub personal access token, in the open
